propositions: Transport parameters in core reconciler modules lack proper type annotations, allowing silently untyped ports that escape static analysis even when annotations are present if imported via unresolvable paths

Absolute imports from rebar_reconciler.* (via sys.path injection) resolve to Any under mypy's ignore_missing_imports setting, defeating enforcement even when parameters are annotated with TicketTransport
Relative imports from ._backend within reconciler modules restore mypy's type checking and enable attribute-checking of TicketTransport-typed parameters against both declared and capability members

Capability members (add_comment, set_relationship, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) are declared as metaclass attributes rather than class body members so plain transports can still conform, but mypy cannot see them and reports them as missing when parameters are correctly typed and imported
